_readme: Greylock's 2011-2014 Rails site served each company as a ~600-byte partial at /companies/<id> carrying the name, a one-line sector, the website, the OUTCOME ('Merged with Creative BioMolecules in 2000', 'Acquired by Cisco') and the Greylock PARTNER on the deal. The Internet Archive enumerated that namespace as numeric ids only, so the pages were unreadable as a company list; Common Crawl's index, read directly off data.commoncrawl.org by scratch/cc-direct.py while index.commoncrawl.org was down, has 270 of them. This is the status and partner layer for the one stretch of the book that the 1999-2010 listings and the modern site both miss. Membership still comes from the wayback layer; the outcome wording is evidence for the judge, never a label.
